license_required.quote: Permits to engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state shall be issued by the board

issuing_authority.value: Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy
issuing_authority.quote: Board means the Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy

name.value: Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy
name.quote: Board means the Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy

type.quote: It is the purpose of the Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy to protect the welfare of the citizens of the state

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate or higher degree plus 150 semester hours (for permit issuance); baccalaureate or higher degree plus 120 semester hours (for exam eligibility on or after January 1, 2025)
degree_required.quote: completed at least one hundred fifty semester hours or two hundred twenty-five quarter hours of postsecondary academic credit and has earned a baccalaureate or higher degree from a college or university accredited by a regional accrediting agency as recognized by the United States Department of Education

accrediting_body.value: Regional accrediting agency as recognized by the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: college or university accredited by a regional accrediting agency as recognized by the United States Department of Education or a similar agency as determined to be acceptable by the board

degree_level.quote: has earned a baccalaureate or higher degree from a college or university accredited by a regional accrediting agency as recognized by the United States Department of Education

school_approval_basis.quote: college or university accredited by a regional accrediting agency as recognized by the United States Department of Education or a similar agency as determined to be acceptable by the board

credential_pegged.quote: who has completed the educational requirements specified in section 1-116

required.quote: Two years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board, in any state or foreign country, in employment as an accountant in a firm, proprietorship, partnership, corporation, limited liability company, or other business entity authorized in any state to engage in the practice of public accountancy under the supervision of an active certified public accountant

experience_source.quote: Two years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board, in any state or foreign country, in employment as an accountant in a firm, proprietorship, partnership, corporation, limited liability company, or other business entity authorized in any state to engage in the practice of public accountancy under the supervision of an active certified public accountant

duration.value: 2 years (public accounting firm) or 3 years (government/business/academic) or 2 years (Auditor of Public Accounts/Dept of Revenue)
duration.quote: Two years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board, in any state or foreign country, in employment as an accountant in a firm

kind.value: Supervised accounting experience under an active CPA permit holder
kind.quote: in employment as an accountant in a firm, proprietorship, partnership, corporation, limited liability company, or other business entity authorized in any state to engage in the practice of public accountancy under the supervision of an active certified public accountant

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountants' Examination
exams.notes: Board may use the Uniform CPA Exam or Advisory Grading Service. Prior to January 1, 2025, 150 semester hours required before sitting; on or after January 1, 2025, 120 semester hours required before sitting.
exams.quote: The board may make such use of all or any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountants' Examination or Advisory Grading Service, or either of them, as it deems appropriate

interval_years.quote: may be renewed biennially for a period of two years by certificate holders and registrants in good standing upon payment of a biennial renewal fee as established by the board not to exceed three hundred dollars

renewal_fee_usd.quote: biennial renewal fee as established by the board not to exceed three hundred dollars

required.quote: As a condition for renewal of a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136, the board, pursuant to rules and regulations adopted and promulgated by the board, may require permitholders to furnish evidence of participation in professional development in accounting, auditing, or related areas for fifteen days within the preceding three calendar years

period_years.quote: professional development in accounting, auditing, or related areas for fifteen days within the preceding three calendar years

topical_requirements.quote: professional development in accounting, auditing, or related areas

available.quote: The board may, in its discretion, waive the examination described in section 1-114 and may issue a reciprocal certificate as a certified public accountant to any person who possesses the qualifications specified in subdivision (2)(a) of section 1-114 and section 1-116 and who is the holder of a certificate as a certified public accountant, then in full force and effect, issued under the laws of any state

requirements.value: Reciprocal certificate available by discretionary waiver of exam or mandatory waiver of exam and education requirements for holders of a valid out-of-state CPA certificate who meet Nebraska residency/place-of-business requirements and, for mandatory waiver, have at least 4 years of experience in public accountancy within the past 10 years.
requirements.quote: the board shall waive the examination described in section 1-114 and the educational requirements specified in section 1-116 and shall issue a reciprocal certificate as a certified public accountant to any person who possesses the qualifications specified in subdivision (2)(a) of section 1-114, who is the holder of a certificate as a certified public accountant, then in full force and effect, issued under the laws of any state, who meets all other current requirements of the board for issuance of a certificate as a certified public accountant, and who, at the time of the application for a reciprocal certificate as a certified public accountant, has had, within the ten years immediately preceding application, at least four years of experience in the practice of public accountancy

exists.quote: It is the purpose of the Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy to protect the welfare of the citizens of the state by assuring the competency of persons regulated under the Public Accountancy Act

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall assume or use the title or designation certified public accountant or the abbreviation C.P.A. or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that such person is a certified public accountant unless such person (1) is classified as inactive under section 1-136 or (2) has been issued a certificate as a certified public accountant under sections 1-114 to 1-124 and holds a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136 which is not revoked or suspended

credential_type.quote: Permits to engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state shall be issued by the board

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall sign or affix his or her name or any trade or assumed name used by him or her in his or her profession or business with any wording indicating that he or she is an accountant or auditor or with any wording indicating that he or she has expert knowledge in accounting or auditing to any accounting or financial statement or to any opinion on, report on, or certificate to any accounting or financial statement unless he or she holds a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136 which is not revoked or suspended

title_protection.quote: No person shall assume or use the title or designation certified public accountant or the abbreviation C.P.A. or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that such person is a certified public accountant unless such person (1) is classified as inactive under section 1-136 or (2) has been issued a certificate as a certified public accountant under sections 1-114 to 1-124 and holds a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136 which is not revoked or suspended

scope_protection.quote: No person shall sign or affix his or her name or any trade or assumed name used by him or her in his or her profession or business with any wording indicating that he or she is an accountant or auditor or with any wording indicating that he or she has expert knowledge in accounting or auditing to any accounting or financial statement or to any opinion on, report on, or certificate to any accounting or financial statement unless he or she holds a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136 which is not revoked or suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a CPA certificate, practice privilege, temporary practice privilege, registration, or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant or the practice privilege or temporary practice privilege, registration, or a permit under the Public Accountancy Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of sections 1-151 to 1-161 (unlawful use of titles)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of sections 1-151 to 1-161

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a rule of professional conduct adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a rule of professional conduct adopted and promulgated by the board under the authority granted by the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or of the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime involving dishonesty or fraud under the laws of any state or the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime, an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as CPA or public accountant in any other state (other than for nonpayment of fees)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant in any other state, for any cause other than failure to pay a registration fee in such other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a certificate holder or registrant to obtain a permit within three years from expiration of last permit or three years from issuance if no permit was ever obtained
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a certificate holder or registrant to obtain a permit issued under section 1-136, within either (a) three years from the expiration date of the permit last obtained or renewed by the certificate holder or registrant or (b) three years from the date upon which the certificate holder or registrant was issued his or her certificate or registration if no permit was ever issued to him or her

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each office established or maintained in this state for the practice of public accountancy in this state by a certified public accountant, by a partnership of certified public accountants or a limited liability company of certified public accountants registered under section 1-126, or by a corporation registered under section 1-134 shall be registered annually under the Public Accountancy Act with the board.

definition_quote.value: Permit means a permit to engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state issued under section 1-136
definition_quote.quote: Permit means a permit to engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state issued under section 1-136

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Nothing in the Public Accountancy Act or the rules and regulations adopted and promulgated under the act shall be construed to prohibit any person who does not hold a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136 from preparing, compiling, or signing financial statements if an accompanying report, letter, or other statement does not express an opinion or other form of assurance as to the fairness, accuracy, or reliability of such statements.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: completed at least one hundred fifty semester hours or two hundred twenty-five quarter hours of postsecondary academic credit and has earned a baccalaureate or higher degree

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: On or after January 1, 2025, any person making initial application to take the examination described in section 1-114 is eligible to take the examination if he or she has completed at least one hundred twenty semester hours or one hundred eighty quarter hours of postsecondary academic credit and has earned a baccalaureate or higher degree

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: without the need to hold a certificate or a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136, or to notify or register with the board or pay any fee

value: To the personal and subject-matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
To comply with the Public Accountancy Act and the rules and regulations adopted and promulgated under the act

That in the event the authorization to engage in the practice of public accountancy in the state of the person's principal place of business is no longer valid, the person will cease offering or rendering professional services in this state
To the appointment of the state entity which issued the person's authorization to engage in the practice of public accountancy as the person's agent upon whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: Any person of another state exercising the practice privilege afforded under this section and any partnership, limited liability company, or other allowed entity of certified public accountants which employ that person hereby simultaneously consent, as a condition of the exercise of the practice privilege

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: Any person who exercises the practice privilege afforded under this section and who, for any entity with its home office in this state, performs attestation services, may only do so through a firm or an affiliated entity which holds a permit issued under section 1-136.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: Such owners shall not hold, in the aggregate, directly or beneficially, more than forty-nine percent of such firm's equity capital or voting rights or receive, in the aggregate, directly or beneficially, more than forty-nine percent of such firm's profits or losses

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: firms may have owners who are not certified public accountants if the following conditions are met

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board may adopt and promulgate rules and regulations to require a firm to enroll in and comply with all requirements of a board-approved program of peer review and comply with all restrictions placed on any permit by the board in response to the results of a peer review.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Any certificate holder or registrant who has not lost his or her right to issuance or renewal of a permit and who is not actively engaged in the practice of public accountancy in this state may file a written application with the board to be classified as inactive.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each office shall be under the supervision of a manager who holds a permit issued under section 1-136 which is in full force and effect.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a certified public accountant incident to or in the course of professional service to clients by such accountant, except reports submitted by a certified public accountant to a client, shall be and remain the property of such accountant in the absence of an express agreement between such accountant and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Nothing in the Public Accountancy Act or the rules and regulations adopted and promulgated under the act shall be construed to prohibit any person who does not hold a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136 from preparing, compiling, or signing financial statements if an accompanying report, letter, or other statement does not express an opinion or other form of assurance as to the fairness, accuracy, or reliability of such statements.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The board may, in its discretion, grant a person who holds a certificate, degree, or license in a foreign country constituting a recognized qualification for the practice of public accountancy in such country, and who does not hold a certificate or permit issued by this state or any other state and whose principal place of business is outside this state, the privilege to temporarily practice in this state on professional business incident to his or her regular practice outside this state

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any such action evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by the Public Accountancy Act shall be sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any person who exercises the practice privilege afforded under this section and who, for any entity with its home office in this state, performs attestation services, may only do so through a firm or an affiliated entity which holds a permit issued under section 1-136.
